name: sudont
description: Sudon't - a puzzle before you scroll. Adds a small pause before distracting websites open.

scripts.build: pnpm clean && pnpm icons && pnpm compile && pnpm bundle && pnpm copy-static
scripts.copy-static: cp manifest.json dist/manifest.json && cp src/blocked.html dist/blocked.html && cp src/options.html dist/options.html && cp -r icons dist/icons
